properties.summary: Memory query endpoints (GET /memory/query) and MemoryStore::search_semantic SHALL sort results by timestamp descending before enforcing limit ceilings, ensuring newest records are returned when total matches exceed limit. Pinned priority records in semantic search also sorted newest-first before truncation.
requirements: Deterministic Newest-First Truncation on Memory Queries
Deterministic Pinned Record Truncation in Semantic Search

Continuous CI/CD Token Optimization and Latency Verification

properties.summary: Hierarchical task graph planning solver, goal stack scheduling, and continuation checkpointing. TaskGraph uses petgraph::DiGraph<TaskNode,()> with A* search over belief state transitions. ExecutiveScheduler maintains goal_stack (Vec<StackFrame>) and ticks with SelfModel health and CoherenceChecker gate_write checks; pre-empts to Diagnostic StackFrame on fault. ContinuationCheckpoint serializes active stack frames as MemoryType::Reflexion records into MemoryStore<B>.
requirements: Hierarchical Task Graph State-Space Planning Solver
Active Goal Stack Scheduler with Pre-emptive Diagnostics
